incidents.name: GROK token pair-balance accounting
incidents.notes: GROK's transfer logic let the attacker shrink the Uniswap V3 pool's own GROK balance during a flash swap, so the position could be closed against a manipulated pool balance and the pool's WETH extracted.

sources.ref: onchain review: GROK 0x8390a1DA07E376ef7aDd4Be859BA74Fb83aA02D5 created 2023-11-04T04:19:11Z by 0xf9387ac9f61cc22994a59a6008f827435ce744b6, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (5.9 days). ~26 ETH x $2,120.46 at incidentTimestamp 1699584695 (DefiLlama) = $55,132.
